name: Bamboo sticky rice
summary: Sticky rice cooked in a bamboo tube and eaten from the tube.
origin: A 2012 provincial feature names cơm lam among Ban Ang’s local dishes.
howToEat: Eat it from the tube at a Ban Ang meal.
No stall price was recorded. The price is check on arrival.
In Mai Châu, Vietnam Tourism says peel the tube and dip the rice in minced peanuts at a Bản Lác or Pom Coọng homestay. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Bản Áng, about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43. Eat the rice from the tube.
In Mai Châu, the homestay table in Bản Lác and Pom Coọng. The photograph filed with this dish was taken in the Central Highlands, and the skewer in that frame is a different grill.
seoTitle: Com lam in Moc Chau — bamboo sticky rice at Ban Ang
seoDescription: Sticky rice cooked in a bamboo tube and eaten from the tube.
